name: Fintech, Banking & Web3 UX
description: High-trust financial UX rules covering transaction safety, fee/rate transparency, numerical legibility, and risk prevention.

name.tr: İşlem Onayı ve Geri Döndürülemezlik Koruması

description.en: Financial actions (transfers, payments, trades, subscriptions) must display a crystal-clear pre-execution summary (recipient, amount, fees, net total, timing) and prevent accidental double-submission.
description.tr: Finansal işlemler (transfer, ödeme, alım-satım) işlem öncesi net bir özet (alıcı, tutar, komisyon, net toplam, valör) göstermeli ve yanlışlıkla çift gönderimi engellemelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clear review/confirmation steps before committing funds, explicit breakdown of amount + fee = total, clear recipient verification, and unambiguous primary action labels (e.g., 'Send $250.00' instead of 'Submit').
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Transaction Confirmation & Irreversibility Safeguards'. Are high-stakes financial actions protected by clear summaries, explicit button labels, and error safeguards?

scoring_rubric.0-20: High risk of financial mistakes, vague 'Submit' buttons, no review/confirmation clarity
scoring_rubric.21-40: Weak transaction previews, easy to misread amounts or submit unintended actions
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic confirmation exists but lacks detailed summary or explicit action labeling
scoring_rubric.61-80: Solid safeguards and clear action labels with minor improvements possible
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — bulletproof transaction review, explicit CTAs, strong mistake prevention

name.tr: Sayısal, Para Birimi ve Tablo Okunabilirliği

description.en: Balances, rates, percentages, and ledger tables must use unambiguous formatting (proper thousand separators, decimal precision, explicit currency symbols/codes, tabular numerals, and color+sign for gains/losses).
description.tr: Bakiyeler, oranlar, yüzdeler ve hesap tabloları net biçimlendirme (binlik ayırıcılar, ondalık hassasiyet, açık para birimi kodları, hizalı rakamlar ve artış/azalış için renk+işaret) kullanmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: consistent thousand/decimal separators, explicit currency symbols + ISO codes ($ USD, € EUR, ₺ TRY), `+`/`-` signs alongside green/red colors (never color alone), and right-aligned tabular numbers.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Numerical, Currency & Tabular Legibility'. Are monetary amounts, percentages, and financial figures formatted clearly and accessibly?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Unformatted raw numbers, missing currency symbols, reliance on red/green color alone
scoring_rubric.21-40: Inconsistent decimal/thousand formatting, hard-to-scan financial figures
scoring_rubric.41-60: Readable numbers but missing tabular alignment or `+`/`-` indicators for colorblind users
scoring_rubric.61-80: Well-formatted currency and numbers with minor typography/alignment gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — crisp tabular numbers, explicit currencies, accessible gain/loss indicators

description.en: Commissions, spreads, interest rates (APR/APY), exchange rates, and regulatory risk disclaimers must be surfaced in plain language alongside figures—never buried in hidden footnotes.
description.tr: Komisyonlar, makas aralıkları, faiz oranları (APR/APY), döviz kurları ve yasal risk uyarıları rakamların hemen yanında anlaşılır bir dille gösterilmeli, gizli dipnotlara gömülmemelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: upfront fee breakdowns, live/timestamped exchange or interest rates, clear distinction between fixed and variable rates, and legible regulatory/risk disclosures.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Fee, Exchange Rate & APR/Risk Transparency'. Are fees, rates, conditions, and financial risks disclosed honestly and prominently?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Hidden fees, misleading yield/return claims, illegible or missing risk disclosures
scoring_rubric.21-40: Important cost/rate conditions buried in tiny footnotes or external PDFs
scoring_rubric.41-60: Rates and fees are mentioned but require effort to calculate net outcome
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear fee and rate presentation with minor improvements in plain-language explanations
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — complete cost/rate transparency, clear calculations, readable disclosures

name.tr: Güvenlik Göstergeleri, Lisans ve Güven Güvencesi

description.en: Financial interfaces must project institutional reliability through clear licensing/regulatory registration info, encryption/2FA indicators, privacy assurances, and zero visual glitches.
description.tr: Finansal arayüzler; açık lisans/regülasyon bilgileri, şifreleme/2FA göstergeleri, gizlilik güvenceleri ve kusursuz görsel tutarlılıkla kurumsal güven vermelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: regulatory/licensing disclosures (FDIC, FCA, BDDK, PCI-DSS, SOC2), security explanations near sensitive inputs, masked sensitive data toggles, and polished layout consistency.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Security Posture, Licensing & Trust Assurance'. Does the interface inspire financial trust through clear security cues, regulatory transparency, and visual polish?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Looks suspicious or unprofessional, no regulatory/company identity, broken UI elements
scoring_rubric.21-40: Weak institutional trust signals, sensitive inputs lack security reassurance
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic company/legal footer exists, but security cues aren't surfaced contextually
scoring_rubric.61-80: Strong trust and regulatory presence with minor contextual security enhancements possible
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — institutional-grade trust, contextual security cues, transparent licensing

name.tr: Kritik Girdi Biçimlendirme ve Hata Önleme

description.en: Inputs for IBANs, card numbers, wallet addresses, tax IDs, and monetary amounts must use auto-spacing/masks, real-time checksum/format validation, and clear min/max balance constraints.
description.tr: IBAN, kart numarası, cüzdan adresi, vergi/TCKN ve tutar girdileri otomatik boşluklandırma/maskeleme, anlık format doğrulaması ve net alt/üst limit kontrolleri kullanmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: grouped formatting for long numbers (e.g., 4-digit IBAN/card chunks), visible available balance/limits next to amount inputs, instant inline validation, and copy/paste safety.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'High-Stakes Input Formatting & Error Prevention'. Do forms and numerical inputs guide the user with masks, balance limits, and instant validation?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Raw unvalidated text boxes for sensitive financial inputs, no limit/format guidance
scoring_rubric.21-40: Errors only shown after form submission, hard-to-read ungrouped account/card numbers
scoring_rubric.41-60: Standard validation present but lacks input masking or contextual limit hints
scoring_rubric.61-80: Well-constrained inputs and helpful validation with minor ergonomic gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — smart input masks, real-time validation, clear balance/limit bounds

description.en: Users must never wonder 'Where is my money?'. Pending, processing, completed, and failed states require clear timestamps, reference IDs, expected settlement times, and downloadable receipts.
description.tr: Kullanıcılar asla 'Param nerede?' diye endişelenmemelidir. Bekleyen, işlenen, tamamlanan ve başarısız işlemler net zaman damgaları, referans numaraları ve dekont/makbuz sunmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: distinct semantic badges for Pending/Completed/Failed states, human-readable timestamps, copyable reference/transaction IDs, and clear timeline expectations for settlements.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Transaction Status Tracking & Auditability'. How clearly are account states, processing timelines, status badges, and historical records communicated?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Ambiguous status states, no timestamps or reference info, users left in the dark
scoring_rubric.21-40: Vague status labels without expected completion times or audit details
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic status labels exist but lack detailed timeline or receipt/reference access
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear status badges and timestamps with minor auditability improvements possible
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — transparent settlement timelines, clear status badges, full audit trail

description.en: Serve both everyday users and financial analysts by showing essential summary metrics first while offering expandable breakdowns, plain-language glossary tooltips, and advanced views on demand.
description.tr: Önce temel özet metrikleri gösterip, istendiğinde açılabilir detaylar, finansal terim ipuçları (tooltip) ve gelişmiş görünümler sunarak hem günlük hem uzman kullanıcılara hitap edin.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clean summary cards paired with 'View details' expandables, tooltips explaining financial jargon (APY, slippage, margin, withholding), and uncluttered primary views.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Progressive Disclosure of Financial Complexity'. Does the design simplify complex financial concepts while keeping detailed breakdowns accessible?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Overwhelming financial jargon and dense data dumped without explanation or hierarchy
scoring_rubric.21-40: Either overly simplified (missing crucial details) or overly dense for normal users
scoring_rubric.41-60: Reasonable balance of info, though some financial terms lack inline explanation
scoring_rubric.61-80: Good summary-to-detail hierarchy and helpful explanations for most terms
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — approachable summaries, rich drill-downs, clear inline financial tooltips

name.tr: Acil Destek, İtiraz ve Hesap Dondurma Erişimi

description.en: When something goes wrong (suspicious activity, failed transfer, lost card), users need immediate, visible paths to freeze accounts/cards, dispute transactions, or reach human support.
description.tr: Bir sorun yaşandığında (şüpheli işlem, başarısız transfer, kayıp kart) kullanıcılar kart/hesap dondurma, işlem itirazı veya canlı desteğe ulaşma adımlarına anında erişebilmelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: easily discoverable help/security contact channels, clear 'Report a problem' or support actions, and reassuring guidance for urgent account issues.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Urgent Support, Dispute & Freeze Accessibility'. If a user encounters a financial discrepancy or security concern, how easily can they find help or protective actions?

scoring_rubric.0-20: No support or security contact options visible anywhere on the page
scoring_rubric.21-40: Support buried behind circular FAQ bots with no clear path for urgent issues
scoring_rubric.41-60: Standard contact/help link in footer, but not surfaced for high-stress scenarios
scoring_rubric.61-80: Accessible support and security help options with minor discoverability gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — prominent, reassuring support and security action paths
